summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a stock exchange announcement detailing share purchases made under its long-term incentive plans. The company acquired 3,916,615 ordinary shares between 18 August and 2 September 2026, including transactions on Euronext, CBOE, DXE, and Turquoise at prices around €17 per share. This is a routine disclosure of compensatory share purchases, not a special situation such as an acquisition or tender offer.
